reviews.title: Amazing app until it introduced addictive games - massive bait and switch
reviews.text: I used to love this app! It was so helpful - my relationship with addictive apps wasn’t miraculously solved but it certainly helped. I blocked every addictive website too, so I can’t doom scroll anymore. BUT THEN ScreenZen introduced a section called “practice” which is meant to replace scrolling activities (but for some reason keep you on your phone). It has a game called “blocks” which is basically infinite tetris. I have lost hours of sleep to this incredibly addictive game and I can’t find a way to delete it, nor can I block it with my app blocker because it’s in this app blocker. It feels like a massive bait and switch, like the developers went “oh no this was working too well!” Nobody needs these games, I don’t know what they’re for.

reviews.title: Don’t put addictive games on this app
reviews.text:
This app has developed really well over the last couple of years. It used to be buggy, but it works pretty smoothly now. Until you add all these “ practice instead of scrolling” activities that include really addictive games like a version of Tetris. I literally sat on my phone, playing your stupid games for three hours after just having to disable the block for a minute to look something up on an app that I had blocked. It’s awful.

Have breathing have meditation that’s fine, but have them all time out after 30 seconds first of all, and don’t put addictive games on here. What are you trying to do?

reviews.title: Thank Goodness for Screen Zen
reviews.text:
Overall, great app. All the good is below. I want to start with my gripe in hopes that the makers fix it.

I got a new phone and I guess transferring my data temporarily disabled the app. I then got a warning that my streaks would be wiped if disabling happened again. I understand why you wouldn’t want people to be disabling the app, but I don’t like that I honestly didn’t do anything wrong and almost got punished. If my streaks get wiped for something that is beyond my control, I’m done with the app. 

I legit haven’t spent more than 2hrs on any social media since the day I got this app (I also got it for my laptop) and it’s probably been 4-5 months at this point. 

Some of the things I like most include that it’s free, and, to my recollection, you don’t have to put in any personal info which is big nowadays (I hate giving up personal identifiers especially if I don’t understand why it’s even needed in the first place). 

Delaying the opening of the app is genius and probably most effective for me. But it also helps that… 

1) I added a custom note that pops up when I open a blocked app and while I wait for it to unlock (mine gives me alternatives to doom scrolling) and 

2) the app includes a streak count. it’s helpful to see how long you’ve abstained and you can be competitive with it if that’s helpful for you. it’s also nice to be able to say I haven’t spent more than 2hrs on social media for 157 days (not that I’m going around saying things like that :))
